# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_STACK_BOS_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A bullish EMA ribbon (EMA8 > EMA13 > EMA21) combined with a confirmed break of structure (BOS) via a new higher high signals a high-probability continuation of the uptrend. This filters out false ribbon reclaims by requiring both structural alignment and volume confirmation, capturing edge in trending regimes where momentum persists after structural breaks.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** EMA8 > EMA13 > EMA21 AND price makes a new higher high that breaks the prior swing high (BOS) AND close > EMA8 AND volume > 1.2 * average_volume_last_5_bars.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the prior swing low (structure invalidation) or a chandelier trail (3×ATR), whichever is tighter. Target at 2R (twice the initial risk), then trail the runner with a premium‑stop of 0.5% of the entry premium.
